2. 3. Within 30 days, the head of radiotherapy and the clinical team decide which schedule-mix and distance-band figures to report yearly, serving "Regional differences in treatment are available and used to steer services (cross-cutting indicator)" [S26].

Distances are road km from municipality centre points, and yearly figures cover breast alone [S59, S60, S57].
